categories.name: Datapack SSG
categories.faq:
**Q:** What is this category ?
 **A:** This category is Datapack Set Seed Glitchless. You have to beat the game **on the gravel SSG seed** using the mod Tyche.
 
 **Q:** What is Tyche and where do I find it ?
 **A:** Tyche is a mod that remove RNG : flint drop, mobs, spawn, dragon perch... You can find it [here](https://github.com/VoidXWalker/tyche/releases/latest)
 
 **Q:** What is the gravel SSG seed ?
 **A:** The gravel seed is `-3294725893620991126`, only works in 1.17 !

categories.name: Perfect Seed
categories.faq:
**Perfect Seed Glitchless**

**Q:** What is the objective of this category?
**A:** Using a hand-built seed, that given a large enough number of possible seeds, is *theoretically* possible to generate, beat the game as fast as possible.

**Q:** Where do I download the map?
**A:** [Here!](https://github.com/BlockOfNetherite/PSG/releases/)

**Q:** The timer isn't working properly, how do I fix it?
**A:** It could be because the PSG map does not need to finish world generation, meaning the timer won't start. To fix this, use the start on old worlds option in the settings of SpeedrunIGT in newish versions

**Q:** Is there a reset macro for this category?
**A:** Yes, there are multiple versions, which can be found in the <#936173705397145651> channel.

categories.name: Creative No Inventory
categories.faq:
**Q:** What is this category ?
 **A:** This is Creative No Inventory, you have to beat the game in creative, without using the creative inventory.
 
 **Q:** Can I use commands ?
 **A:** Using commands or switching gamemode is forbidden, and we recommand disabling cheats when creating the world.
 
 **Q:** How do I pickup a block or duplicate an item ?
 **A:** Use middle click to pickup a block, or get a stack of the item you middle clicked.
 
 **Q:** I can't craft in creative, how can I make eyes of ender or other stuff ?
 **A:** You have to find a naturally generated crafting table. All structures generated with one are listed [here!](https://discord.com/channels/936167959431364628/936386037264039987/959664336396226581)]
 
 **Q:** How do I kill blazes or endermen ?
 **A:** The main strat is to use beds, since they blow up in the nether. You do not have to kill him with your bare fists. Reminder : You have to punch the blaze before blowing him up, or else he will never drop anything.
 
**Q:** Do I have to beat the ender dragon ?
 **A:** No, you only need to enter the credits. To do this, you can pickup the end portal frames, and rebuild the portal when entering the end.

categories.name: Break Beenest
categories.faq:
**Q:** What is this category ?
 **A:** Read the title.
 
 **Q:** I got a time of under 450ms, why did my run got retimed to 450ms ?
 **A:** The time it takes to break a beenest is 450ms, even if your timer says otherwise. The only way to do it in less than 450ms is to loot a gold axe in a ruined portal chest then break the beenest.
 
 **Q:** Is there an SSG seed with a gold axe in a ruined portal ?
**A:** Yes! `1108912127130472088` (1.16.1), seed found by DylanDC14.

**Q:** SpeedrunIGT Extension ?
**A:** [JSON Extension](https://discord.com/channels/936167959431364628/936174026496290856/1017356525133643776) (Put it in /speedrunigt/categories/), [Mod Extension](https://github.com/RedLime/BreakBeeNestExtension/releases/latest) (Put it in mods folder). You then just have to select "Break Beenest" in speedrunigt category (or "Break Bee Nest" for the mod extension)

categories.name: All Arthropods
categories.faq:
**Q:** What is this category ?
**A:** All Arthropods. You have to kill each arthropod at least once.

**Q:** What are the arthropods in Minecraft ?
**A:** Spider, Cave Spider, Silverfish, Endermite (1.8+), Bee (1.15+).

**Q:** If an arthropod dies without me doing anything, does that count as a kill ?
**A:** No. For it to count as a kill, the arthropod must die as a result of a player's actions.

**Q:** I killed an arthropod, but I was running away as it finished dying. How do I prove I killed it ?
**A:** The statistics menu, progress towards the Monsters Hunted advancement, visually seeing the death animation, and subtitles all count as a way to confirm the kill.

**Q:** Is there a custom SpeedrunIGT Extension for All Arthropods ?
**A:** Yes! Download it [here!](https://github.com/RedLime/AllArthropodsExtension/releases/latest).

categories.name: Low%
categories.faq:
**Q:** What is  this category?
 **A:** Beat the game while collecting the fewest possible advancements along the way.

  **Q:** What is a root and what does the split between with and without roots mean?
 **A:** Roots are the base advancements of each tree (Minecraft, Adventure, Husbandry, Nether, End). As such they are triggered by very basic action in the game, making them difficult to avoid. As such, there is a category split, that does not count roots. Although the names may be a bit confusing, "Without Roots" means roots do not count, and you are allowed to get them. The opposite goes for the "With Roots" split.

  **Q:** What advancements are needed to complete the game?
 **A:** In RSG, only the We Need To Go Deeper, the root of the nether tree, The End?, and the root of the end tree are needed. In SSG, the nether advancements aren't necessary, reducing the number to 2, and when roots aren't counted, only 2 are necessary.

  **Q:** What is the extra split 3-5 or 5-7?
 **A:** These are to add extra strategy to the routing, make the category more accessible for runners who don't want to learn all of the skips, or to allow runners to submit runs that they choked by accidentally getting an advancement.

  **Q:** How do I avoid getting X advancement?
 **A:** For item based advancements, use what is known as the GUI skip, where when in a GUI other than you inventory, the inventory update trigger will not trigger until you close that container.
 For structure based advancements, there is a mixture of dodging the structure's hitbox or abusing the fact that the location advancement trigger on checks your location every 1s.
 **There is plenty of other information, including setups and more specific advancement skips on the routing doc, which can be found [here!](https://docs.google.com/document/d/17HUK2nWZTHMi-WZEQZDKFkCbxnJ231B_ObKctj-Yvms/)**

categories.name: Zombie Doctor
categories.faq:
**Q:** What is this category ?
**A:** You need to obtain the Zombie Doctor advancement, which is obtained by curing a Zombie Villager.

**Q:** How do I cure a Zombie Villager ?
**A:** You need to apply the effect Weakness to it first (by using a throwable potion or a tipped arrow), then feed it a (non-enchanted) golden apple.

**Q:** How long does it take to cure ?
**A:** Basic time is a random time between 3 and 5 minutes. However, you can slightly speed it up by placing **irons bars** and/or **beds** in a 9x9x9 cube centered on the Zombie Villager. [More informations here!](https://discord.com/channels/936167959431364628/988343391337185360/988501235931955210)

categories.name: Mojang Banner
categories.faq:
**Q:** What is this category ?
**A:** This is Mojang Banner%, you need to obtain a [Mojang Banner](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/547121208425185280/1004355004687200407/unknown.png).

**Q:** How do I do that ?
**A:** You need to make a red-colored banner, then use it in a loom with the "Thing" Banner Pattern and a white dye.

**Q:** And how do I get the "Thing" Banner Pattern ?
**A:** You need to get an Enchanted Golden Apple and craft it with a paper.

categories.name: Superflat Mine a Chunk
categories.faq:
**Q:** What is this category ?
**A:** Mine a whole chunk (except bedrock) in a superflat world.

**Q:** How do I reset fast ?
**A:** [Atum](https://github.com/VoidXWalker/Atum/releases/latest) 1.1.0 and above allows you to reset superflat worlds.

**Q:** How do I deal with slimes ?
**A:** Mine the 2 bottom layers first, then hope. You can also dig a chunk close to the Iron Golem so it yeet them to the moon.

**Q:** Can I use a custom preset ?
**A:** No.

**Q:** What shovels are faster ?
**A:** Diamond and Gold shovels are the fastest for dirt, but Gold shovel is faster for grass blocks.

categories.name: All Nametags
categories.faq:
**Q:** What is the goal of this category ?
**A:** Get all nametags easter eggs.
> - `jeb_` (sheep)
> - `Toast` (rabbit)
> - `Dinnerbone` (any mob)
> - `Grumm` (any mob)
> - `Johnny` (vindicator)

**Q:** How do I get nametags ?
**A:** You can find them in chests (Dungeon, Mineshaft, Mansion, Ancient City), fish them (0.83%), or trade for them (20 emeralds with a Master Librarian).

**Q:** SSG Seed ?
**A:** `15061867208` (mansion), found by hyoka !
